item.description: Giffgaff is able to offer full fibre using the nexfibre XGS-PON network and started selling on parts of the network back in September 2025. item.description: The true power of 5G should now be available to O2 mobile customers in 66 large towns and cities, 175 smaller towns, and 1,120 villages across Scotland. item.title: Ofcom fines 4chan for non-compliance with the Online Safety Act
item.description: Ofcom has announced that it is fining the anonymous imageboard website 4chan for non-compliance with the Online Safety Act. Ofcom has found that 4chan is still in breach of three duties – it has failed to protect children from encountering pornographic content through the use of highly effective age assurance, and this failure is ongoing.
